definitions: A political ideology advocating for a democratic political system alongside a socialist economic system, with a focus on social ownership of the means of production and distribution, often through public, cooperative, or state ownership.
A political movement that seeks to achieve socialist goals within a democratic framework, typically through electoral means and gradual reforms.
examples: Many proponents of democratic socialism advocate for universal healthcare.
The debate around democratic socialism often involves discussions of economic equality.
Historically, democratic socialism has influenced various European political parties.
